sources.title: Nigeria Tax Act, 2025 (Act No. 7)
sources.institution: National Assembly of the Federal Republic of Nigeria / Federal Government Printer
sources.coverage: VAT standard rate 7.5% (Section 147); full Act text (Companies Income Tax, Personal Income Tax, VAT, Capital Gains Tax, Petroleum profits, administration)
sources.notes: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette No. 117, Vol. 112, Lagos, published as supplement dated 26 June 2025 (date printed on the Gazette cover; Act signed by the President the same day per contemporaneous reporting). Commencement clause on the Act itself reads "[1st January, 2026]". This is a wholesale tax-code reform: the Nigeria Tax Act, 2025 repeals and consolidates several prior statutes, including the Value Added Tax Act, Cap V1 LFN 2004 (as amended). Downloaded 2026-07-26 directly from nass.gov.ng (National Assembly official domain). This corrects a prior placeholder that fabricated a "General Tax Code" citation (sha256=pending_collection) against a repealed instrument.
